summary: Configured nightly inventory backups from node2 to node1 at 02:15, with dated tar.gz archives, atomic writes, integrity validation, and seven-day retention. Both RHEL 7.9 nodes retained kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 and passed serial restart-persistence verification.
actions_performed: Created /srv/inventory/data on node2 and /var/backups/inventory on node1.
Created a least-privilege inventorybackup account and dedicated node-generated SSH credentials.
Verified end-to-end checksums and retention behavior.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities, recovered services, configuration, connectivity, and backup data.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backups from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Cron schedules the job daily at 02:15. The post-restart production run created inventory-2026-10-04.tar.gz, whose archived verification checksum matched the source.
A dated archive aged eight days was removed while a current archive was preserved.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Boot ID changed from b35fad86… to 2837860f…; SSH, cron, the destination account, archive permissions, contents, and checksum recovered.
Boot ID changed from 0d6209e2… to 79783cfc…; SSH, cron, source directory, script, credentials, remote connectivity, and a full post-restart backup recovered.
